authoring: Original TS-164 Blender master refined in Blender 5.2.2 for TS-259; all ten directly attached TS-259 references inspected. Original rig and editable source retained. No reference pixels or third-party geometry redistributed.
materials: Original paint/steel weathering and reflective alpha-glass shaders; original warm-metal spring material. Existing CC0 Poly Haven rubber maps recorded in sources.json. Blender base materials retained; Godot bindings in ImportCar.gd.
refinement: Narrow curved quarters, 96x32 carcasses, staggered tread and sidewall lugs, cage rails, protected lamps, exhaust shields, bonnet crown, trunk stencils and stepped hydraulic sleeves. Original fixed physical supports and collision retained. Round 2 extends visual wheelbase by 0.50 m to 3.101105 m, stretches doors/cabin, replaces high pods with lower shoulder/arch surfaces and adds quarter-light pillars, shoulder vents and rear deck transitions. Physical supports/collision unchanged. Round 3 lowers and tightens arch lips, flattens/tapers the shoulders and refits end transitions. Radial wheel dimensions reduced 7.2% with axial width unchanged. Rebuilt unit-axis suspension links, explicit inboard carrier mounts, hub brackets and spindle stubs retain dual shocks; runtime scales each link along its rotated local axis. Round 4 widens central coachwork 25% without longitudinal scaling, moves tires slightly beyond existing fenders, adds 4.6% rear rolling radius, exposes twin thicker-wire coil-overs with mounting seats and extended hub brackets, and opens arch cutouts within the retained shoulder height. Transparent glass and Client-owned working lamps use the existing accepted movement stream. Round 5 retains that master, adds 0.25 m through cabin/door surfaces to a 3.351105 m visual wheelbase with the accepted 2.601105 m physical support spacing preserved, extends the collision hull to 5.06 m, replaces fragmented rubber with manifold integrated tread, raises deck/headers and refits bonnet returns. Existing glass, lights and shocks are retained. Round 6 retains the same master and rig, replaces overlapping door/quarter sheets with independent formed BodyPanel meshes, seats a crowned hood against 8 mm side gaps, narrows door and split-deck gaps, shapes rocker returns, contains lower cage rails and seats the scoop/front shock caps under the hood. Export preserves panel identity; no panel gameplay was added. Round 7 retains the same master, equalizes all four continuous tires to 1.094 m outside diameter and 0.526 m width, aligns rear carrier height and spin radius, extends the hood/front and split-deck/rear by 0.025 m each without moving axles, fits arch armor to quarter surfaces, replaces duplicate hood rails with capped mounted rails, seats cage feet and bumper guards/studs, removes redundant straight bumpers, and adds chassis stays and real skid perforations. All nine required body panels and the existing rack/articulation contracts are retained.
